comments.content: PR commits are collected as tree SHAs (`x.GetCommit().GetTree().GetSHA()`), but build's ledger keys each CheckpointRecord by the commit SHA (`git rev-parse HEAD` in build.go). `rec.Checkpoints[c]` therefore never matches, so the build record is never used: every non-delegated PR falls to 'unknown' and the fix for Bug #171 (family from a record the PR cannot change) never takes effect; honest PRs also lose their known family and get needlessly restricted reviewers. Use the commit SHA (`x.GetSHA()`).

`covered` is true when any single commit has a checkpoint record (`named > 0`), contradicting the doc comment ('a checkpoint naming a model family for every commit') and the Source text that claims the record names it 'for all %d commit(s)'. A PR that adds extra, unrecorded commits (e.g. by another model, or by hand) on top of one recorded checkpoint is treated as fully attributed to the recorded family, so the unrecorded commits' builder is not a candidate and a same-family reviewer can be chosen. Require `named == len(commits)`.

Inverted condition: `lane == "" && lane != verbs.FamilyHostManaged` only runs when lane is empty, so `add(lane)` is a no-op and the note prints an empty family; when there is a real build-lane family it is never added. With no ledger record and no/forged trailer, the lane default (the likely actual builder family) is excluded from Candidates, so the reviewer may be of the builder's own family — the exact gap Bug #171 is meant to close. Should be `lane != "" && lane != verbs.FamilyHostManaged`.
